transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts — Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600 — I need to confirm a few things. Per our standing Monday personnel-sync routine, I need the company commanders and S-1 officer to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Alpha, Bravo, and the battalion support staff will each provide one team, and no team covers more than one shift. I also need to make sure every assignment includes a named shift handoff on the final roster. Let's start by hearing from each of you on your availability and any personnel changes I should be aware of.
